svg.title: Proposed Type 2 acquisition and fault workflow
svg.desc: The DAC is the sole timing authority. Audio starts only after DAC timing, returned-reference recovery and transport discipline are valid. Both endpoints retain finite-buffer protection, bounded holdover and a new-session restart rule.
